svg.aria-label: Brainfuck memory: 15 zero-initialized cells, pointer at cell 0

g.metadata: Offline execution of random/message.bf, verified against source/main.md. 8-bit wrapping cells; real memory sampled for playback. The 15-cell viewport follows the pointer. No interpreter runs in CGI.

Landing lettering: Alte DIN 1451 Mittelschrift by Peter Wiegel. Copyright (c) 2017 Peter Wiegel. SIL Open Font License 1.1. Source: https://www.peter-wiegel.de/alteDin1451.html. License distributed in random/fonts/Open Font License.txt. Output lettering: WebPlus IBM VGA 8x16 by VileR, Oldschool PC Font Pack v2.2, https://int10h.org/oldschool-pc-fonts/, CC BY-SA 4.0; converted to SVG outlines. License: random/fonts/VGA-LICENSE.txt.
